26/S0.subgoal: Explain the physiology of perception, including the role of sensing organs, neural impulses, and the physical structure of the cerebral cortex.

26/S1.subgoal: Explain the architecture of the brain's neural network, including neuron structure, graph-based modeling, and synaptic connections.

26/S2.subgoal: Describe how hierarchical processing allows the brain to detect increasingly complex patterns.

26/S3.subgoal: Explain how the brain combines real-time sensory input with long-term experience to interpret stimuli.

26/S4.subgoal: Describe proprioception as a 'sixth sense' for sensing body position and muscle effort.

26/S5.subgoal: Explain how discrepancies between sensory inputs and brain processing can lead to cyber sickness.

26/S6.subgoal: Explain the concept of vection and the design principles for creating balanced immersive experiences.

26/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
